subject: joule operator standard operating procedure
opening: Operators run joule as a GUI-first local pool or multi-agent internet cluster: dumb-user start path, production CUDA engine with content-proof weights, band-only peer-seeded shards (not full multi-TB on every box), fleet honesty for full Kimi, contribute-to-consume economy, and ship only when cargo gates and the docs pack are green.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This SOP defines day-to-day operation of a joule lab or standing pool: quality gates, dumb-user join path, donor contribution control, full-Kimi fleet honesty, live capacity visibility (CLI and GUI), production smoke, and the release ship flow for f00-sh/joule.

sections.heading: 2a. Native installers
sections.body: Prefer OS installers from permanent site links or GitHub Releases. Files live on GitHub; joule.f00.sh only redirects (website only — not a weight CDN).
items: Permanent: https://joule.f00.sh/current/ and download.html
Windows: joule-windows-x86_64-setup.exe (or versioned *-setup.exe)
macOS: joule-darwin-aarch64.pkg or .dmg
Linux: sudo dpkg -i joule-linux-x86_64.deb
CLI: curl -fsSL https://joule.f00.sh/current/install.sh | sh

sections.heading: 2b. Dumb-user local pool (preferred)
sections.body: Do not invent ports for first light. Use the shipped one-shot path so control and agent come up together.

steps.text: GUI path: run joule, click star DO EVERYTHING (local pool). First open auto-starts if :7700 free (JOULE_GUI_NO_AUTO=1 skips).
Show Base URL + joule_ key + model for OpenAI clients.
Contributor chat (requires healthy agent for that account).

sections.heading: 2. Day-to-day operator gates
sections.body: Before exposing any gateway or telling donors the pool is open, complete these checks in order. Fail closed on any red step.

steps.text: Release-binary economy smoke (2 agents, freeloader deny, contributor chat).
Start local pool (GUI or start) and confirm capacity backends ≥ 1.
Attach a second agent for multi-node join when claiming a multi-backend pool.
Confirm GUI Overview shows backends and connection state; Graphs zoom/pan work.

sections.heading: 3. Full Kimi honesty (do not overclaim)
sections.body: Full Kimi is one logical device across donors. Never tell users every box must download multi-TB weights.
items: Production quant: kimi-k3-shards — 96 real moonshotai/Kimi-K3 LFS digests in models/MANIFEST.json
Band/shard residency only per donor; peer-seed by sha256; f00 is website only
Fleet gate full_k3_service_fleet_ok: ≥64 GiB healthy aggregate VRAM and ≥3 backends
Service digests SoT is production K3 (production_digests_ok); lab complete alone is not service_live
Lab fixtures (lab-tiny/mid/large) = protocol CI only — not production Kimi quality
Commit-gated quant upgrade: try_commit_* — fleet K3 recommend without bytes must not brick lab serve
Agents use ProductionEngine (ADR 0003 CUDA driver FFI) with content-proof stage/infer

sections.heading: 4. Donor local controls (law 5)
sections.body: Remote operators cannot raise local caps. Agents reload the policy path passed with --policy. Schedule windows use OS local timezone (tm_gmtoff on Unix).
items: Pause/resume: joule donor pause|resume or GUI Donor tab / tray
VRAM cap: joule donor set-cap N (0 clears) or tray --donor-set-cap
Schedule / thermal / battery: donor policy JSON or GUI Donor tab
Status: joule donor status — prints local schedule and sensors

sections.heading: 5. Economy closed loop
sections.body: Public pool: no cash. Freeloaders without a healthy agent for the account get HTTP 401/403. Contributors chat on the OpenAI-shaped path after mint from contribution.
items: Verify freeloader deny and contributor chat via production-smoke.sh
Millijoules: eco=v0 fairness (√VRAM, tenure, leecher)
Single model: kimi-open only

sections.heading: 6. Release ship flow
sections.body: Ship only when gates are green. Documentation pack is mandatory: CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README, Pages, man, SOP PDF, this-version NASA memo PDF, SemVer tag, GitHub Release assets (CI on tag v*).

sections.heading: 7. Product laws (do not violate)
items: Compute is the only currency on the public pool — no money
No contribution ⇒ no API access
Credits = sealed hash-chain millijoules only; verified VRAM only for mint/placement
Single model: kimi-open
One logical device: N donors = one virtual GPU (sum of healthy VRAM)
Website is not a weight CDN — content-addressed peer seed only
Not every box downloads full multi-TB weights — band/shard slices
